name: Armed and Ready
summary: You carry Morbent's Bane back to Sven Yorgen, a weapon made to break Morbent Fel's unholy defenses.

sections.title: A Weapon Forged
sections.body: Ordinary steel cannot break Morbent Fel's hold over Raven Hill cemetery. Blades shatter or glance from the dark wards around him. Grimand Elmore shaped the metal in Stormwind's Dwarven District, and sacred power consecrated it. Now Morbent's Bane can sever Fel's tie to unlife.

sections.title: Return to the Hermit
sections.body: At his lonely camp near Duskwood's western border, Sven Yorgen has watched the darkness ruin his family, farm, and companions. You bring him Morbent's Bane, and he recognizes its divine craftsmanship and the fire in your eyes. With the weapon in his hands, Sven can strike at the master of Raven Hill.

faq.answer: Morbent's Bane is a weapon forged and consecrated to break the magical wards around Morbent Fel at Raven Hill.
Grimand Elmore, a blacksmith in Stormwind City's Dwarven District, fashioned the weapon from consecrated lightforge iron.

faq.q: Where do I deliver Morbent's Bane?
faq.answer: You deliver Morbent's Bane to Sven Yorgen at his camp in western Duskwood, near the Westfall border.

faq.q: Why can't Sven Yorgen fight Morbent Fel himself?
faq.answer: The dark forces in the woods drove Sven Yorgen from his home and cost him his family and companions. Isolated and hunted, he depends on Alliance champions to avenge them.

faq.q: What happens after completing Armed and Ready?
aliases: next quest after armed and ready
faq.answer: After Sven receives the blessed weapon, he sends you to Raven Hill Cemetery to face Morbent Fel and strike him down.

faq.q: What is the quickest route back to Sven's camp?
aliases: how to get to sven quickly
faq.answer: From Sentinel Hill in Westfall, travel east across the river to reach Sven's camp. This is shorter and safer than going west through Darkshire's dangers.

angles.text: As a paladin, you know holy power joined with dwarven steel can break wards that protect the undead.
As a blacksmith, you can see how Grimand Elmore joined fine smithing with sacred rites to make a weapon against supernatural threats.
As an Alliance member, you see Stormwind artisans give survivors in Duskwood the skill they need to confront the spreading blight.
